description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

LNW Gaming, Inc. (KAC) is hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and integrate software products. The role contributes features, modernization, code improvements, shared libraries, and bug resolution for Light & Wonder products alongside a global engineering team.
Software Engineer developing product features and shared libraries, modernizing and refactoring code, and resolving bugs

Responsibilities:
• Work with a team to develop innovative features and functionality for Light & Wonder products, utilities, and tools
• Research new technologies to modernize and elevate existing Light & Wonder products
• Work on refactoring, improving, and optimizing existing code base
• Design and build libraries that will be shared with other Light & Wonder product
• Embrace best coding practices, such as secure coding guidelines, test driven development, continuous integration workflow
• Provide prompt resolution to bugs/issues by using debugging skill

Requirements:
• Knowledge of C# and C++
• Knowledge of Client-Server Architecture basics
• knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) Concepts and Principles
• Familiarity with Database Architecture
• Have a high degree of comfort with software development tools such as IDEs/compilers, debuggers, profilers, and version control systems
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
• Excellent teamwork skills
• Excellent problem-solving skills and an analytical mindset

Preferred:
• Gaming industry experience
• Knowledge of SQL query writing
• Familiarity with Web UI design
• Knowledge of Operating System's basics
• Knowledge of PowerShell
• Familiarity with development tools such as Visual studio, Perforce, Git, Jira, etc
